title: A Language for the Postcards
author: Juniper Okonkwo
blurb: Jude Crane, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
